newsitem.title: FRANCE: Jet Multimedia aims for 25-30 mln Ffr 1998 profit.
newsitem.headline: Jet Multimedia aims for 25-30 mln Ffr 1998 profit.

text.p: Jet Multimedia, a French specialist in on-line services, aims to have net attributable profit of between 25 million and 30 million francs ($5.3 million) in 1998, Chairman Eric Peyre said.
"In terms of net profit, our aim is 25 to 30 million francs in 1998", he told a news conference on Wednesday.
The company's traditional activities should show growth of three to four percent, he added.

Jet Multimedia had net attributable profit of 18.4 million francs in 1996, more than double the 7.1 million it posted in 1995, on turnover of 167.5 million francs in 1996 against 116.1 million in 1995. Some 80 percent of its turnover derives from Internet connections, with value-added services accounting for the rest.

Peyre said Jet's France Explorer software, which allows a user to access all online services from a single terminal without taking out a subscription, would not weigh significantly on the company's 1997 results.
Jet spent 30 million francs developing this product. It had 45,000 users and over 200,000 paid-for connections at the end of April.
"We are the first group to charge for Internet use on a time basis," Peyre said, adding he did not expect a competitor on this front before January 1998.
Using Internet with France Explorer costs some 70 francs a minute, of which Jet receives 44 francs. DT/SLA ($ = 5.705 French Francs)
